issue.title: Persistent SASE gateway services on Athena and Apollo
issue.description: Athena and Apollo run their loopback-only SASE gateways from enabled, durable, chezmoi-managed user services that survive process failure and host restart without disrupting the existing Tailscale Serve endpoints or Apollo enrollment.

issue.title: Add the managed gateway unit
issue.description: provision-service: add and validate the host-scoped chezmoi source for the permanent user unit.

issue.title: Deploy and verify both gateways
issue.description: rollout-services: apply the landed unit on Athena and Apollo, replace the transient proof service, and verify restart-safe health.

payload.description: derived from the plan's `bead_id:` frontmatter field

payload.entry: Added chezmoi-managed user unit gated to athena/apollo only; verified systemd-analyze --user verify, chezmoi rendered unit contents, hostname-gated managed inclusion/exclusion, git diff scope, and dotfiles just check.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: restore managed dispatch alias for apollo — `sase machine status apollo -j` cannot run from Athena because `dispatch.machines` is empty in the loaded config, even though the existing `fleet:apollo` credential and catalog entry are present and Apollo gateway health is ok.

rollout-services verified: Athena applied managed sase-gateway.service from landed chezmoi source after live source update was blocked by dirty dotfiles checkout, target unit matches source, service enabled/active/non-transient from ~/.config/systemd/user, loopback listener on 127.0.0.1:7629, local health ok, Apollo-to-Athena tailnet health ok, and explicit restart stayed healthy. Apollo ran /home/bryan/bin/chezmoi update -a --force to 287bcd32, target unit hash matched managed source, proof unit stopped before permanent service start, permanent service enabled/active/non-transient from ~/.config/systemd/user, sole loopback listener on 127.0.0.1:7629, proof inactive, local health ok, Athena-to-Apollo tailnet health ok, explicit restart stayed healthy, and direct fleet hello with existing fleet:apollo credential returned ok/hello ok for the pinned installation. Required literal 'sase machine status apollo -j' is blocked by missing dispatch.machines.apollo config; PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP recorded on this bead.

LANDING VERIFIED: Reviewed the epic record, linked plan, both closed phases, and every child note. Source/commit verification: chezmoi commit 287bcd328 adds only the Athena/Apollo-gated .chezmoiignore rule and the 13-line user unit; the unit uses the stable uv-tool gateway, binds only 127.0.0.1:7629, shares %h/.sase, wants/starts after network-online.target, restarts on failure after 5s, and installs under default.target. systemd-analyze --user verify passes, the linked chezmoi tree is clean, and its full just check passes. Live recheck on 2026-09-09 confirms Athena and Apollo services are enabled, active/running, loaded from ~/.config/systemd/user/sase-gateway.service, linger-backed, and each owns the sole loopback 7629 listener; Apollo proof service is inactive. Both local health endpoints and both cross-tailnet HTTPS health probes return healthy sase_gateway protocol 1, and both installed unit hashes equal the committed source. Phase .2 also recorded successful explicit restart checks and authenticated Apollo hello without changing credentials. Post-start drift: reviewed main commits 1852f091a (xprompt alias completion) and a1b08d06c (artifact-sidecar preservation), including their source diffs; neither overlaps, duplicates, or should consume gateway supervision. Chezmoi has no post-287bcd32 drift. Verification monitor p42rjgz2v8xf passed every format/lint/SASE/committed-plan stage and all 39,956 tests with 14 skips and zero global leak poisonings. It exited only at the pre-existing test-cost budget defect: three aggregate CPU causes narrowly exceeded tolerance. This epic adds no SASE tests or ACE/parser/pilot code; the exact recording is file:explicit:cfdd2c7e9c2bc6a7137a14d8 and independent evidence was added as +1 #6 to existing ready task sase-xc, with no budget change or redundant task. FOLLOW-UP DISPOSITIONS: (1) sase-yt.2 note #1, missing dispatch.machines.apollo for sase machine status, remains reproducible but predates and is independent of gateway supervision. Duplicate/recent-task searches found no standalone match; it is recorded on causal active remote-dispatch epic sase-xe.16.11 note #2 for phase .11.5 to restore durably, so no task was created. (2) The non-failing core-floor advisory is also unrelated: the two v0.32.53 checkpoint-recovery capabilities are already recorded on causal active epic sase-yh note #3, while the still-unpublished filter_model_alias_shortcut_entries capability is now recorded on causal active epic sase-ys note #1. Older tasks sase-wg and sase-xn concern distinct already-exceeded bindings, so neither was corroborated and no duplicate task was created. No unresolved issue caused by sase-yt remains, and epic-symbol inspection found no entries.
